title: When the Machine Falls
author: A. M. Dunmore
blurb: Quentin Ravensworth, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
